Bug_Title: MS: Public static method may expose internal representation by returning a mutable object or array (MS_EXPOSE_REP)
Bug_Details:
A public static method returns a reference to a mutable object or
 an array that is part of the static state of the class.
 Any code that calls this method can freely modify
 the underlying array.
 One fix is to return a copy of the array.
Bug_Explanation: The method 'getInternalState()' returns a reference to the 'internalState' array. Thus, any code that calls this method can freely modify the underlying array.
Trigger_Explanation: Both test cases fail, demonstrating that the bug in the original code is exposed by the public static method getInternalState(). The testBug method fails because it modifies the internal state of the class.

Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results confirm the presence of the bug in the Java code. The testGetInternalState test fails because the internalState array is modified in the test itself. This is a violation of the rule MS_EXPOSE_REP, which states that a public static method should not return a reference to a mutable object or array. The testShowBug test also fails because it calls the showBug method, which modifies the internalState array. This is also a violation of the rule MS_EXPOSE_REP.
